invariants.rationale: At least one of parent or template should be non-null, or the merge would return null which is unlikely given the method's semantics.
The parent JsonValue is expected to be a map/object or null, as inferred from the merge logic.
The template JsonValue is expected to be a map/object or null, as inferred from the merge logic.
parent and template should not be the same object, as merging an element with itself is unlikely the intent.
If parent is null, template should be a valid object for the merge to return a valid result.
